race.comment: CITY GOLD FIELD (2) may have suffered from the dreaded second-up syndrome last time out but go on the solid Sunny Coast victory when resuming. Strikes a race decimated by scratchings and can bounce right back without surprising. NINE MIL (13) broke the maiden status at Lismore on debut before being tipped out for further time to furnish. Revved up for this with a recent trial and winning hoop Mallyon reunites. Right in this contest. MAJESTIC LOUVRE (14) will be rock-hard fit for this and draws the inside alley. Top-three commodity. FLYING VENTO (10) won on debut and shouldn't be underestimated.
